title: Profile
description: A complete serialized profile; vectors are streamed by the future writer.

analysis.description: Analysis results and explicit completion state.

graph.description: Aggregated span-to-span graph, not an execution DAG.

memo.description: Memoization results; absent unless `#[memo]` or `#[trace(memo_probe)]` recorded data.

objects.description: Object-tracking results; absent unless the `object-tracking` feature recorded data.

roots.description: Retained per-invocation root snapshots, ordered by start time and UID.

schema_version.description: Format version. Only version 1 is defined by this draft.

spans.description: Static span descriptors, sorted by stable identity before assigning IDs.

threads.description: Participating threads, including threads that have exited.

AccessKind.description: How a path was reached in source.

oneOf.description: Read without a mutable borrow.
Assigned, compound-assigned, or borrowed mutably.
Method receiver, or the whole argument passed on.

AccessSite.description: Execution count of one source access site.

type_id.description: Type ID of the tracked argument.

Analysis.description: Analysis envelope containing evidence-backed deterministic or optional results.

insights.description: Evidence-backed insights; never use fake scores for unimplemented algorithms.

sections.description: Named sections (critical_paths, clusters, embedding, complexity, changepoints, anomalies).

AnalysisSection.description: Completion information and a draft algorithm-specific result payload.

data.description: Draft payload; replace with typed results before publishing analysis support.

explanation.description: Explanation of skips, limitations, or computation assumptions.

AnalysisStatus.description: Analysis completion state for the run or an individual section.

oneOf.description: Algorithm completed with the available evidence.
Algorithm was disabled or not run.
Available evidence cannot support a meaningful result.
Cooperative deadline expired; no claim of complete results.

dropped_records.description: Records lost to overflow or other diagnosed collection failures.

evicted_roots.description: Roots evicted from the bounded history, distinct from unsampled roots.

heap_tracked.description: Whether an installed `TrackingAllocator` observed heap operations, so the optional `memory` sections of chains and roots are present.

pending_threads.description: Thread IDs without an acknowledged checkpoint for this epoch.

rss_supported.description: RSS capability; zero RSS alone never indicates support.

sample_rate.description: Probability of retaining an independently sampled root/subtree.

sampled_out_roots.description: Exact observed counters are never rescaled by the sampling probability.

snapshot_complete.description: Whether all requested participants acknowledged this snapshot epoch.

Chain.description: Observed aggregate statistics for an interned call chain.

active_ns.description: Inclusive active time, excluding suspension between future polls.

alloc_bytes.description: Gross allocation bytes attributed directly to this chain, excluding profiler work.

allocs.description: Successful allocation/reallocation operations attributed directly to this chain.

cancelled.description: Subset of invocations dropped before successful completion.

m2_ns2.description: Welford centered sum of squares (M2), not a raw sum of squares.

max_ns.description: Maximum observed duration, or zero for an empty aggregate.

mean_ns.description: Arithmetic mean of observed wall durations.

memory.description: Heap balance from the tracking allocator; absent unless `meta.capture.heap_tracked`.

min_ns.description: Minimum observed duration, or zero for an empty aggregate.

path.description: Nonempty path of span IDs from root to leaf.

poll_count.description: Number of future polls; zero for synchronous spans.

self_time_kind.description: Meaning of `self_ns`; wall time is not additive across concurrent tasks.

std_ns.description: Population standard deviation of observed wall durations.

total_ns.description: Sum of inclusive wall durations of observed invocations.

ChainMemory.description:
Heap balance of a chain across its invocations.

Direct values count operations while the chain was the innermost active span (`alloc_bytes` and `allocs` on the chain itself are the direct allocations); inclusive values add completed child spans. A deallocation is charged to the span that frees the block, which may differ from the one that allocated it. Sizes are requested bytes, not allocator block sizes.

freed_bytes.description: Bytes freed directly by this chain.

frees.description: Direct deallocations; a reallocation counts one free and one allocation.

incl_alloc_bytes.description: Allocated bytes including completed child spans.

incl_freed_bytes.description: Freed bytes including completed child spans.

net_bytes_max.description: Largest inclusive net heap change of one invocation (positive retains memory).

net_bytes_min.description: Smallest inclusive net heap change of one invocation (negative releases memory).

peak_bytes_max.description: Largest single-invocation heap high-water mark above the entry level.

peak_bytes_sum.description: Sum of per-invocation high-water marks; the mean is this over `count`.

peak_histogram.description: Per-invocation high-water mark distribution, same bucket layout as durations.

retaining_calls.description: Invocations that returned with more live heap than at entry.

oneOf.description: Returned normally, with no known unfinished propagated children.
Future dropped before completion or function unwound.
Root ended with unfinished children or incomplete capture evidence.

Dependency.description: Causal relationship between exclusive segments, recorded explicitly.

from.description: Source segment ID within the same root.

to.description: Destination segment ID within the same root.

oneOf.description: Parent initiated a child; this alone does not imply a later join.
Source completed before destination could resume.
Sequential execution with an observed happens-before relationship.

Evidence.description: IDs for evidence navigation; references must resolve in this profile.

oneOf.description: Optional event capture was disabled.
Required start, finish, and dependency evidence was retained.
Some events or causal relationships are missing.
The configured evidence limit was reached.

ExecutionEvidence.description: Optional bounded evidence for an invocation DAG.

dependencies.description: Explicit causal dependencies between segments, not aggregate invocations.

invocations.description: Recorded invocation intervals; IDs are local to this root.

segments.description: Non-overlapping active segments split at spawn, join, and suspension events.

status.description: Whether causal evidence is sufficient for observed critical-path analysis.

ExecutionSegment.description: Active exclusive interval, split at every captured causal boundary.

id.description: Root-local segment identifier, in a namespace separate from invocation IDs.

invocation.description: Invocation that directly owns this exclusive execution segment.

t_end_ns.description: Monotonic end offset from the capture origin.

t_start_ns.description: Monotonic start offset from the capture origin.

thread.description: Thread executing this segment; a future can have segments on different threads.

FieldStats.description: Counters for one path of one type within one function.

calls.description: Executed method-call sites; the method may or may not mutate.

changes.description: Calls after which the value at this path differed.

path.description: Path relative to the type; empty for the whole value.

Graph.description: Aggregated call graph; recursive span paths can produce cycles.

nodes.description: Measurements summed by terminal span identity.

total_ns.description: Sum of inclusive child wall durations, potentially overlapping.

GraphNode.description: Aggregated measurements for a span across all chains.

Histogram.description: Bounded histogram representation; boundaries carry their actual approximation.

buckets.description: Increasing, non-overlapping buckets with inclusive upper bounds.

precision.description: Human-readable precision/configuration; no unqualified exact quantile claim.

HistogramBucket.description: Observed duration frequency below one inclusive upper bound.

upper_ns.description: Inclusive upper duration bound in nanoseconds.

Insight.description: Human-readable conclusion backed by explicit profile identities.

evidence.description: Profile objects that support this conclusion.

explanation.description: Evidence, assumptions, and limitations in plain language.

Instance.description: One observed instance and its history.

cloned_from.description: Instance this one was cloned from, when both were observed.

field_changes.description: Change count per path relative to the instance; `[*]` stands for any index or key.

history.description: Most recent version transitions, oldest first.

history_dropped.description: Transitions evicted from the bounded history.

key.description: Display key, unique within the type.

parent.description: Instance that contained this one when it last changed.

replaced_by.description: Instance that replaced this one in place during a tracked call.

InstanceCalls.description: One instance's counters for one function.

calls.description: Calls that received this instance as a tracked argument.

changed_calls.description: Calls after which this instance's value differed, directly or as a nested instance.

touches.description: Executed access sites on this instance.

Invocation.description: Observed invocation interval within a root.

oneOf.description: Number allocated by `InstanceId`.
Application key from a `#[tracked(id)]` field.
Memory address; approximate, because moves change it and addresses are reused.

Memo.description: Counters of memoized functions and repetition evidence from probes.

functions.description: `#[memo]` functions that ran at least once, sorted by name.

MemoFunction.description: Cache counters of one `#[memo]` function, summed over its caches.

bypasses.description: Calls that skipped the cache because of `toggle`.

misses.description: Calls that ran the body because the key was absent.

MemoProbe.description:
Argument repetition observed on one probed span.

Fingerprints are 64-bit hashes of `MemoKey` values: evidence for a memoization candidate, not a proof that calls were identical.

distinct_args.description: Distinct argument fingerprints among tracked calls.

inconsistent_args.description: Argument fingerprints that produced more than one result fingerprint.

inconsistent_calls.description: Repeated calls whose result differed from the first call with the same arguments.

repeated_calls.description: Calls whose fingerprint had been seen before (`calls - untracked_calls - distinct_args`).

repeated_ns.description: Inclusive time of repeated calls: what a cache could have saved.

total_ns.description: Inclusive wall time of all calls.

untracked_calls.description: Calls with a new fingerprint after the distinct-fingerprint limit was reached.

MemoryBucket.description: Invocations whose high-water mark fell below one inclusive upper bound.

Metadata.description: Capture metadata with explicit data-quality information.

duration_ns.description: Monotonic elapsed capture duration in nanoseconds.

git_sha.description: Application source revision if supplied by the host.

host.description: Host facts; do not include environment variables or credentials.

threads.description: Number of registered threads, including exited threads.

version.description: Application version if supplied by the host.

dropped_instances.description: Instances first seen after the limit was reached; their calls are not counted.

ObjectType.description: A type that derives `Tracked`, or the Rust type of a tracked argument.

Objects.description: Tracked instances, field counters, and access sites from `#[trace(track(...))]`.

fields.description: Per-function counters for each path of each type.

instances.description: Observed instances, sorted by type and key.

sites.description: Execution counts of individual source access sites.

Root.description: Immutable snapshot of one retained root invocation.

attributes.description: Bounded string attributes recorded for grouping and filtering.

chain_self_ns.description: Root-local exclusive active time per chain, needed for root flame graphs.

completion.description: Completion or cancellation state, including truncated root evidence.

duration_ns.description: Wall duration until completion or cancellation.

execution.description: Causal invocation evidence; aggregates alone cannot give exact critical paths.

memory.description: Heap balance from the tracking allocator; absent unless `meta.capture.heap_tracked`.

metrics.description: Numeric root features; repeated keys use the last recorded value.

outcome.description: Optional application-defined result such as `ok`, `error`, or `timeout`.

rss_entry_kb.description: Linux resident set size at entry, in KiB; zero if unsupported.

rss_exit_kb.description: Linux resident set size at exit, in KiB; zero if unsupported.

t_start_ns.description: Monotonic start offset from the capture origin.

thread.description: Origin thread ID (the future may subsequently migrate).

uid.description: Unique UUID string for this invocation.

RootMemory.description: Heap balance of one retained root invocation, including all its spans.

alloc_bytes.description: Bytes allocated during the root on its own thread and polls.

peak_bytes.description: Heap high-water mark above the level at entry.

oneOf.description: Synchronous same-thread wall time minus directly nested child intervals.
Active execution during polls, minus directly nested active child intervals.
Required evidence was not captured; `self_ns` must be zero.
Informational pattern.
Potential issue requiring interpretation.
High-impact observed issue.

Span.description: Static span identity and source metadata.

file.description: Source file from the instrumented call site.

name.description: Fully qualified default name or the user-supplied name.

tags.description: User-defined labels, sorted and deduplicated on export.

busy_ns.description: Union of instrumented active intervals; nested spans are not counted twice.

exited.description: Whether the thread has published its final checkpoint.

name.description: Optional thread name assigned by the application.

changed.description: Changed paths relative to the instance, at most 32.

lines.description: Source lines of write and call sites executed during the call.

span.description: Span ID of the call that produced it.

t_ns.description: Capture-relative time when the call returned.

version.description: Version number after the change, starting at 1.
